f.pu: The purpose of management in the Natural Reserve of Ilhéu de Maria Vaz is to protect its rocky islet habitats and surrounding marine environment, safeguarding seabird nesting areas and associated biodiversity while maintaining the natural ecological processes of this isolated site.
